summary.text: John Day, a Democratic U.S. Navy veteran and professional writer from Lake Charles, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Louisiana's 3rd Congressional District to Clay Higgins.
The Louisiana Illuminator's voter guide describes him as a writer and film producer.

paragraphs.text: According to his Ballotpedia survey, Day was born in Shreveport, raised in Lake Charles, and graduated from Sam Houston High School.
He served in the U.S. Navy beginning in 1994.
He works as a professional writer and, in his words, is working toward producing film projects; the Louisiana Illuminator's voter guide describes him as a writer and film producer.
He says he is married to Amanda Hardy Day and that they have four grown children.
He received 20.9% of the vote to Clay Higgins's 55.0%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
